story.title: The Great Onion Chopper Debacle
story.question: Can Barnaby sell his chaotic onion chopping helmet before it explodes?
story.answer: Barnaby tests it on a cabbage instead, saving his market stall from total disaster.

story_beats.headline: The Catastrophic Reveal
story_beats.speech: Behold the tearless chopping wonder! No more crying over slicing onions in the bustling town square market.
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands at his messy market stall wearing a bizarre metal helmet with twitching mechanical arms, holding a bruised red onion while nervous townspeople watch.

story_beats.headline: The Jammed Mechanism
story_beats.speech: Oh dear, the gears are locking up tight! The spring tension is increasing rapidly inside this contraption.
story_beats.label: The Malfunction
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically taps the side of his helmet with a small wrench while small puffs of smoke hiss from the brass hinges, making the villagers step back.

story_beats.headline: The Desperate Build
story_beats.speech: Quickly grab that stray cabbage from the crate before the main spring snaps completely out of control!
story_beats.label: The Substitute
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby holds out his hands while his young apprentice toss a round green cabbage directly toward the twitching mechanical blades mounted on the helmet.

story_beats.headline: The Messy Payoff
story_beats.speech: Well, that certainly chopped the cabbage into fine coleslaw, though my dignity is completely ruined forever.
story_beats.label: The Aftermath
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands covered in a green mist of shredded cabbage leaves and vegetable bits, smiling sheepishly at the amused and clapping crowd around his stall.

story.central_conflict: Barnaby invented a spring-loaded onion helmet that mashes vegetables instead of slicing them neatly.
story.decisive_choice: Barnaby pulls the emergency release lever to sacrifice his own invention rather than the customer's stall.
story.resolution: The helmet explodes in a cloud of mist, leaving Barnaby with clean spectacles and a happy audience.

visual_bible.style: Slapstick animated comedy with bright primary colors and exaggerated character expressions.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild gray hair, a stained yellow apron, and round spectacles.
characters.Apprentice: A cheerful teenager in a blue vest carrying wooden crates.

locations.Market Square: A bustling medieval marketplace filled with colorful awnings, wooden carts, and vegetable stalls.

objects.Onion Helmet: A copper helmet featuring spring-loaded steel blades, brass gears, and a red emergency lever.

story.title: The Midnight Express Baggage Mystery
story.question: Who unlocked the conductor's missing antique pocket watch before platform departure?
story.answer: An intelligent station pigeon trained by the retired stationmaster to deliver lost items.

story_beats.headline: The Missing Timepiece
story_beats.speech: Where has the old conductor placed his golden pocket watch? The express departs in exactly five minutes.
story_beats.label: Platform Panic
story_beats.visual_prompt: An anxious conductor in a navy uniform looks at a glowing red departure signal inside a crowded Victorian railway station.

story_beats.headline: The Feathered Sleuth
story_beats.speech: Look up at the iron rafters! That peculiar pigeon is holding something gleaming brightly in its beak.
story_beats.label: Unexpected Ally
story_beats.visual_prompt: A clever grey pigeon wearing a tiny brass mechanical courier harness stands on a high steel girder inside the grand station roof.

story_beats.headline: The Clanking Mechanism
story_beats.speech: Pull the lever on the telegraph pole to lower the maintenance ladder and reach the clever bird.
story_beats.label: The Ascent
story_beats.visual_prompt: The stationmaster pulls a heavy brass lever beside a wooden maintenance door attached to a brick pillar on the bustling platform.

story_beats.headline: Departing on Time
story_beats.speech: The precious watch is back in safe hands, proving that even the smallest helpers can save the day.
story_beats.label: All Aboard
story_beats.visual_prompt: The glowing steam locomotive resembling a majestic land ship puffs white smoke as it rolls smoothly away from the joyful platform crowd.

story.central_conflict: The express train is about to depart without the vital timetable pocket watch.
story.decisive_choice: Follow the trained bird up the iron rafters instead of searching the lost property office.
story.resolution: The pocket watch is safely returned to the conductor just as the whistle blows.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic steampunk illustration with warm lantern lighting and rich Victorian textures.

characters.conductor: A tall, elderly man with a sweeping grey mustache, wearing a dark navy wool uniform and brass buttons.
characters.stationmaster: A stout, cheerful woman wearing a tweed waistcoat, round spectacles, and a pocket watch chain.
characters.pigeon: An exceptionally smart grey homing pigeon wearing a custom-fitted miniature leather backpack.

locations.platform: Grand Victorian railway station with arched iron and glass ceilings, cobblestone floors, and warm gas lamps.
locations.rafters: High structural steel beams dusted with soot, overlooking the bustling steam trains below.

objects.pocket_watch: An antique engraved gold pocket watch attached to a sturdy braided chain.
objects.signal_lamp: A heavy cast iron railway signal post featuring a glowing red mechanical semaphore arm.

story.title: The Frozen Bearing
story.question: Can the thermal core be salvaged in time to save the stranded weather station?
story.answer: Yes, by manually diverting emergency generator fuel through the exterior cooling conduits.

story_beats.headline: Warning Alarm Activated
story_beats.speech: The primary heating grid has dropped below freezing, and the automated fuel pump is completely frozen solid.
story_beats.label: System Failure
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Maeve Vance staring at a blinking red console inside the dimly lit metal research hub, clutching a heavy wool clipboard.

story_beats.headline: Evaluating the Options
story_beats.speech: We cannot wait for the airlift. We must drain the transport snowcat reserve immediately to save the base.
story_beats.label: The Dilemma
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Maeve Vance pointing a gloved finger at a blue schematic blueprint spread across a metal table, looking intently at Engineer Jiao.

story_beats.headline: Manual Override Engaged
story_beats.speech: Hold the conduit steady while I attach the manual siphon line to bypass the frozen intake valve.
story_beats.label: The Action
story_beats.visual_prompt: Engineer Jiao steadying a humming mechanical pump outside in the swirling white snowstorm, wearing an orange heavy-duty parka.

story_beats.headline: Thermal Recovery Confirmed
story_beats.speech: The temperature gauges are finally rising into the green zone. We made the right call to save the crew.
story_beats.label: Safe Harbor
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Maeve Vance and Engineer Jiao smiling warmly inside the bright, heated airlock corridor, holding steaming mugs of tea.

story.central_conflict: Freezing temperatures threatening life support systems during a severe blizzard.
story.decisive_choice: Sacrificing the primary transport snowcat fuel reserve to power the emergency heat lines.
story.resolution: The station maintains safe internal temperatures until the relief team arrives.

visual_bible.style: Realistic gritty cinematic style with cold blue and warm orange contrast lighting.

characters.Dr. Maeve Vance: A resilient arctic researcher with short dark hair, wearing a fur-lined teal parka and rugged snow goggles.
characters.Engineer Jiao: A practical mechanic with a stubbled beard, wearing an orange high-visibility parka and heavy insulated gloves.

locations.Research Hub: A cramped, metallic modular building interior packed with glowing scientific monitors and exposed wiring.
locations.Outer Snow Platform: A freezing outdoor metal deck surrounded by endless white arctic plains and heavy falling snow.

objects.Thermal Core: A cylindrical titanium engine part glowing with a faint blue operational light.
objects.Manual Siphon: A heavy rubberized hose fitted with brass valves and a mechanical hand-crank.
